'''2016 European Championship Day 3 Tom Kelly LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Kelly]] at [[2016 European Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Kelly]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open WYS Kelly LS 2016 EC 2.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125837/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-european-championships.html Internet Archive]
